question.tr: Segment beslemeden mi alınmalı, türetilmeli mi; türetilen segment nasıl çözülüyor ve beslemeyle ne kadar ayrışıyor?
question.en: Should segment come from the feed or be derived; how is the derived segment resolved and how often does it disagree with the feed?

data.tr: load_clean(derived=False) ve load_clean() (29.988 ilan); segment kuralı analysis/lib/segment_rule.py.
data.en: load_clean(derived=False) and load_clean() (29,988 listings); the segment rule in analysis/lib/segment_rule.py.

method.tr: Her ilanın segmenti seri haritasından, model adı tablosundan ya da temel sınıftan çözülür (çözülemeyen kalırsa durur); G segmentinin içeriği, model adından çözülen aileler, birden çok segmente yayılan seriler ve ham segmentle uyuşmazlık sayılır; seri × segment medyan fiyat matrisi.
method.en: Every listing's segment is resolved from the series map, the model-name table or the base class (stops if one is left unresolved); the G segment's make-up, families resolved from the model name, series spanning several segments and the disagreement with the raw segment are counted; a series × segment median price matrix.
